responsibility: Implements the query-side check for whether a type may legally be created from raw uninitialized or zeroed bytes. This file provides the helper used by `rustc_const_eval`’s root query registrations to answer `permits_uninit_init` and `permits_zero_init`, either by running the CTFE interpreter’s allocation and operand validation machinery under strict initialization checking or by falling back to the layout-based `might_permit_raw_init` classification when strict checks are disabled.
